containers.name: exporter
command:
pip install --quiet grpcio protobuf 'elasticsearch<9.0.0' grpcio-tools
# Download Hubble proto files directly from GitHub
apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl
mkdir -p /tmp/cilium/api/v1/flow /tmp/cilium/api/v1/observer /tmp/cilium/api/v1/relay
mkdir -p /hubble-proto/flow /hubble-proto/observer /hubble-proto/relay

# Download proto files directly (faster than cloning)
CILIUM_VERSION=v1.16.5
curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cilium/cilium/${CILIUM_VERSION}/api/v1/flow/flow.proto -o /tmp/cilium/api/v1/flow/flow.proto
curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cilium/cilium/${CILIUM_VERSION}/api/v1/observer/observer.proto -o /tmp/cilium/api/v1/observer/observer.proto
curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cilium/cilium/${CILIUM_VERSION}/api/v1/relay/relay.proto -o /tmp/cilium/api/v1/relay/relay.proto

# Generate Python code from protos
python -m grpc_tools.protoc \
  --proto_path=/tmp/cilium/api/v1 \
  --python_out=/hubble-proto \
  --grpc_python_out=/hubble-proto \
  flow/flow.proto observer/observer.proto relay/relay.proto

# Run exporter
python /config/exporter.py

containers.name: kiwix
args:
# Wait for ZIM files and start Kiwix when available
# Ignore temp files (files being downloaded)
while true; do
  # Count non-temp ZIM files
  ZIM_COUNT=$(find /data -maxdepth 1 -name "*.zim" ! -name "*_temp.zim" 2>/dev/null | wc -l)

  if [ "$ZIM_COUNT" -gt 0 ]; then
    echo "ZIM files found! Starting Kiwix server..."
    # Only serve non-temp ZIM files
    exec /usr/local/bin/kiwix-serve --port=8080 --verbose $(find /data -maxdepth 1 -name "*.zim" ! -name "*_temp.zim")
  else
    echo "No ZIM files found yet. Waiting... (Check every 30 seconds)"
    echo "Run the kiwix-zim-downloader job to download content."
    sleep 30
  fi
done

containers.name: pre-pull-share-manager-image
command: echo share-manager image pulled && sleep infinity

set -o errexit
set -o pipefail
set -o nounset

# When running in AWS ENI mode, it's likely that 'aws-node' has
# had a chance to install SNAT iptables rules. These can result
# in dropped traffic, so we should attempt to remove them.
# We do it using a 'postStart' hook since this may need to run
# for nodes which might have already been init'ed but may still
# have dangling rules. This is safe because there are no
# dependencies on anything that is part of the startup script
# itself, and can be safely run multiple times per node (e.g. in
# case of a restart).
if [[ "$(iptables-save | grep -E -c 'AWS-SNAT-CHAIN|AWS-CONNMARK-CHAIN')" != "0" ]];
then
    echo 'Deleting iptables rules created by the AWS CNI VPC plugin'
    iptables-save | grep -E -v 'AWS-SNAT-CHAIN|AWS-CONNMARK-CHAIN' | iptables-restore
fi
echo 'Done!'

containers.name: zim-downloader
command:
set -e

echo "=== Kiwix ZIM File Updater ==="
echo "Started at: $(date)"

# Install required tools
apk add --no-cache wget curl

# Define ZIM files to download
# Format: "filename|download_url"
ZIM_FILES="
wikipedia_en_all_maxi|https://download.kiwix.org/zim/wikipedia/wikipedia_en_all_maxi_2025-08.zim
stackoverflow.com_en_all|https://download.kiwix.org/zim/stack_exchange/stackoverflow.com_en_all_2023-11.zim
"

cd /data

# Process each ZIM file
echo "$ZIM_FILES" | while IFS='|' read -r name url; do
  # Skip empty lines
  [ -z "$name" ] && continue

  echo ""
  echo "Processing: $name"
  echo "URL: $url"

  # Check if file already exists
  existing_file=$(ls ${name}_*.zim 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 || echo "")

  if [ -n "$existing_file" ]; then
    echo "Existing file found: $existing_file"
    existing_size=$(stat -c%s "$existing_file" 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
    echo "Existing file size: $existing_size bytes"
  else
    echo "No existing file found"
  fi

  # Get remote file info
  echo "Checking remote file..."
  remote_size=$(wget --spider --server-response "$url" 2>&1 | grep -i Content-Length | tail -1 | awk '{print $2}' || echo "0")
  echo "Remote file size: $remote_size bytes"

  # Download if needed (file doesn't exist or size differs)
  if [ -z "$existing_file" ] || [ "$existing_size" != "$remote_size" ]; then
    echo "Downloading new version..."

    # Download to temp file
    temp_file="${name}_temp.zim"
    wget -c -O "$temp_file" "$url"

    # Verify download
    if [ -f "$temp_file" ]; then
      downloaded_size=$(stat -c%s "$temp_file")
      echo "Downloaded size: $downloaded_size bytes"

      # Get date stamp from filename or use current date
      datestamp=$(date +%Y-%m)
      final_name="${name}_${datestamp}.zim"

      # Move to final location
      mv "$temp_file" "$final_name"
      echo "Saved as: $final_name"

      # Remove old version if it exists
      if [ -n "$existing_file" ] && [ "$existing_file" != "$final_name" ]; then
        echo "Removing old version: $existing_file"
        rm -f "$existing_file"
      fi

      echo "Update complete for $name"
    else
      echo "ERROR: Download failed for $name"
    fi
  else
    echo "File is up to date, skipping download"
  fi
done

echo ""
echo "=== Update Summary ==="
echo "Completed at: $(date)"
echo "Current ZIM files in /data:"
ls -lh /data/*.zim 2>/dev/null || echo "No ZIM files found"

echo ""
echo "Total storage used:"
du -sh /data

echo ""
echo "ZIM update process complete!"
